meta.title: File editor
meta.description: Makes text files in the side pane editable: open a file, edit it in place, and save back to disk with Ctrl+S, with stale-version conflict prompts and reload.

error.unsupported: This file cannot be edited here.
error.notText: This file is not valid UTF-8 text and cannot be edited.
error.tooLarge: This file is larger than 4 MB and cannot be edited here.

conflict.banner: The file changed on disk since it was loaded. Reloading discards local changes; saving anyway overwrites the file on disk.
